steps.content: As the last Corruptor meets its end, from behind you comes the electrical sound of the equipment being switched on. The main base station puts up a force field.

Blue light cascades over your surroundings, slowly clearing up the heavy, filthy air. You heave a sigh of relief, and your mind, which has been on the verge of a breakdown since you saw the sufferings of the Legion, finally enjoys a brief respite.
The high concentration of contamination has bent space-time and entirely cut off communications. But this area is free of Corruptors for the time being.

options: I thought you were killed in the MBCC riot

steps.content: You were not wrong to have that thought. They always say I have a face that screams death in the line of duty.
But looks like it's quite the contrary. I'm good at surviving death-guaranteed missions.
He smiles, wearing a nonchalant look.
Me too.

After the riot, I was transferred back to DisSea Surveillance Zone. Only yesterday I heard that you, the new Chief of the MBCC, were doing an excellent job, and the headquarters intended to recruit you to help out in the District of DisSea.
I knew I would meet you sooner or later, but I didn't expect so soon.
Not so long ago, I thought you had been kidnapped by the Legion, and your Sinners had all defected. Guess I was wrong.
You tense up for a second. It's true that only a short while back, you conspired with the Legion to fight these guys. 036 probably did want to save you then, but...
All the other FAC soldiers in his team are evidently on their guard. They still look tense with the way they hold their guns, and you can feel their alert gaze on you even through the visors.
Don't worry, I'm not questioning your stance. Your adjutant has since explained the situation to me. I believe in you, Chief. You must have your reasons for doing so.
But we're in a dire situation. If you were forced to take that action for some special reasons, or you have come upon some special intel, please share it with me, don't keep me in the dark.
I'm not your enemy. The FAC won't be fooled into becoming someone's pawn in some political plot if we can help it, and we don't station our troops somewhere just to stand in someone's way.
We came here only because we had received confidential information: An S-Class or above Mania crisis might break out in Keylan Square. And as you and I have seen, this warning is becoming a reality.
What we've seen might only be the beginning. I have to know more; we have to take action.

You remain quiet for a moment. Then you give a brief account of how the Public Security Bureau and the Legion played games with each other, your worries about the inheritance, and the vague premonition you sensed through the shackles.

...So, That Earl guy from the Legion said the inheritance has been moved, but you can sense it's in the square now, and it suddenly appeared in the conference hall before the outbreak of contamination?

options: To be precise, I sense the same aura as the one from the inheritance

steps.content: Is it possible that they tricked you? Maybe Zoya did bring the inheritance into the conference hall and release it when the negotiation broke down, as a means of retaliation?
As you've said, she possesses a technique that allows her to seal the inheritance completely.
...That <color=#fb9259>white cube</color>. This makes sense. Zoya did hide from you her real reason for attending the negotiation.
But even if Zoya did wish to retaliate, you don't think she would use the thing she most hates as a weapon. She'd prefer her own fists.
And you have a vague but even more unsettling premonition that comes to you through the shackles.

options: I have a feeling that Zoya's under the control of the inheritance now

steps.content: That object once devoured a few dozens of maniac gangsters and extracted fearsome power from them. And it has a fervent craving for Zoya.
If it's the inheritance that's corrupting Zoya, I'm afraid that it must have attained much greater power. And that explains why it could bring about such widespread contamination.
Zoya... she is doing everything she can to fight that thing.
That's what you sensed through the shackles?
The FAC team falls silent.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What's wrong? Why getting so serious all of a sudden?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Captain, what are your orders? We're forever ready. We'll fight alongside you until the very end no matter what.
...I see.
He turns to you.
The information you just gave me is very important.
For that glimmer of hope, we shall continue our fight.
I do. Predicaments faced by the FAC are always beyond easy comprehension, so your contribution is of vital importance.
Thank you for letting us know how dire the situation is, and for giving us the silver lining. And now, for the silver lining, we shall fight to the last man.
Team N7, assemble!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Yes, Chief!
Head for the conference hall immediately and storm the center of contamination. Be prepared to die for the mission. If there's only one man reaching the destination, give him all the firepower.
This is our final mission. Kill Sinner Zoya before the Black Ring breaks out, at all costs.
